description.value: Fab Burgers is a gourmet burger restaurant in Surrey's King George Boulevard corridor, billing itself as the 'Home of the Monster Burger' with handmade burgers including their signature oversized creations. It operates out of a unit in a strip-mall-style commercial building and offers online ordering. A cycling tourist on the King George corridor would find this a convenient stop for a sit-down or takeout burger meal.
